vendors.name: Anchore Enterprise
vendors.offering: Syft-based SBOM generation in CI (AnchoreCTL), central storage and continuous vulnerability monitoring
vendors.pricing: quote; CI/CD pricing by number of scanning stages (AWS Marketplace 12-month contracts from $34,500)

vendors.name: FOSSA
vendors.offering: SCA and license compliance with SBOM export, imports and attribution notices
vendors.pricing: Free plan (SBOM export, 5 imported SBOMs); Business ~$20 per project/month billed annually; Enterprise quote

vendors.name: Snyk (snyk sbom)
vendors.offering: CLI generates CycloneDX/SPDX SBOMs for projects and containers in pipelines
vendors.pricing: Enterprise plan only; price not public

vendors.name: Interlynk
vendors.offering: SBOM platform plus OSS sbomqs/sbomasm for quality, BSI TR-03183 checks, assembly
vendors.pricing: AWS Marketplace contracts from $18,000/year (10 active developers)

vendors.name: sbomify
vendors.offering: Hosted SBOM generation, signing-aware publishing and sharing portal
vendors.pricing: Community $0; Business $159/month billed annually; Enterprise not public

vendors.name: RunSafe Security Platform (Identify)
vendors.offering: Build-time C/C++ SBOM generation for embedded systems

vendors.name: Keysight SBOM Manager
vendors.offering: Generates SBOMs from binaries, firmware and OS images rather than source

vendors.name: Chainguard Containers
vendors.offering: Minimal images each shipped with signed SBOM and provenance attestations
vendors.pricing: free Starter tier; paid plans via sales / AWS Marketplace private offer

paid_market_gaps.gap: Snyk gates SBOM generation and SBOM testing to its Enterprise plan, leaving smaller teams without a paid middle tier
Build-time SBOMs for non-package-managed C/C++ and firmware poorly covered; few commercial options beyond RunSafe
Generated SBOMs often lack purls, breaking matching in paid SCA tools such as Black Duck
BSI TR-03183-2 conformance checking exists mainly as open-source sbomqs, not enforced at generation in commercial tools

wtp_evidence: Buyers pay for SBOM management (Anchore, Interlynk, FOSSA), but generation and signing are free via Syft/BuildKit, GitHub export and AWS Inspector; Snyk monetizes it only inside Enterprise.
bundling_note: GitHub exports SPDX SBOMs and signs SBOM attestations, Docker BuildKit emits SBOMs with --sbom, GitLab Ultimate outputs CycloneDX, and AWS Inspector exports SBOMs at no extra cost.
summary: Weak opening: build-time SBOM generation and signing is commoditized and bundled by GitHub, Docker, GitLab and AWS. Only niche wedge: embedded C/C++ firmware vendors needing CRA/BSI TR-03183-conformant build SBOMs.
